Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist

Record Class RunRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist.RunRecord
Record Components:
seed - the run seed
difficulty - the difficulty
playerName - the adventurer's name
actions - the recorded action tokens, oldest first
public record RunRecord(long seed, Difficulty difficulty, String playerName, List<String> actions) extends Record
Everything needed to recreate a run: the seed, difficulty, player name, and every action taken. A saved game is a run record; so is a bug-report replay.

Text format (one item per line): 

 HALLS7800-RUN 1
 seed=12345
 difficulty=UNDERGRADUATE
 name=Ada
 M:NORTH
 U:2
 ...

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
